mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Explore returns interest over time, by region, and related queries/topics for your search terms. Trending Now returns today's trending searches for one or more countries.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: One line per result. Put up to 5 terms on one line, separated by commas, to compare them on the same scale (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum). Each line is one dataset item.

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country code (US, AR, DE) or region code (US-CA, AR-B). Leave empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Preset time range. Ignored if a custom time range is set.

customTimeRange.title: Custom time range
customTimeRange.description: Optional. Two dates separated by a space: 2024-01-01 2024-06-30. Overrides the preset time range.

category.title: Category ID
category.description: Google Trends category ID, e.g. 0 = all categories, 7 = Finance, 71 = Food & Drink, 958 = Jobs. You can read the ID from the cat= parameter of a Trends URL.

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: Search interest per country, region, city or metro.

regionResolution.title: Region level
regionResolution.description: Level of detail for interest by region. Auto = countries for worldwide, regions/states for a country. Metro (DMA) works only for the US.

includeLowVolumeRegions.title: Include low-volume regions
includeLowVolumeRegions.description: Also return regions with low search volume.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Top and rising related search queries for each term.

includeRelatedTopics.title: Related topics
includeRelatedTopics.description: Top and rising related topics for each term. Off by default: Google currently returns empty topic lists for most automated requests, so this often adds requests without adding data.

trendingGeos.title: Trending Now countries
trendingGeos.description: Only for Trending Now mode. Country codes, e.g. US, AR, GB. Defaults to the Location field, or US.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for names of regions and topics, e.g. en-US, es-AR.

timezoneOffset.title: Timezone offset (minutes)
timezoneOffset.description: Minutes behind UTC, as Google expects it: 0 = UTC, 180 = UTC-3 (Buenos Aires), 300 = UTC-5 (New York, standard time), -60 = UTC+1.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many terms to scrape in parallel. Keep it low to avoid Google rate limits.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries per term when Google rate-limits a request. Each retry uses a new proxy session and waits longer.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google rate-limits shared IPs. The default Apify Proxy works for most runs; switch to the RESIDENTIAL group if you see many retries.
